```{r library}

# Function to load or install packages
load_or_install <- function(packages) {
  for (package in packages) {
    if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
      install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
      library(package, character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

# Required packages 
packages <- c("here"
              , "tidyverse"
              , "readxl"
              , "janitor"
              , "rmarkdown"
              )

# Load or install the packages
load_or_install(packages)

rm(packages)

# if you need captioner
# install.packages("devtools")
# devtools::install_github("adletaw/captioner")

```

```{r load all training data}

# [breadcrumb: in the future, we could bring all HDR data cleaning into this script, 
  # rather than load data that's already been coded]

# load data from the RTDC training spreadsheet (this is the complete number of attendees
  # & includes info about the theme)

df_sp <- read_xlsx(
  here::here("data",
             "raw",
             "2026_spreadsheet_data.xlsx"),
  sheet = '2026 Program',
  skip = 5, #start at the header row
  n_max = 90,  # last session = VC awards
  .name_repair = "unique",
  trim_ws = TRUE) %>% 
  clean_names()

# load RTDC data from ienrol (this contains names of Flinders attendees & includes college/portfolio info)

df_ienrol <- read_csv(here::here("data", "raw", "2026_ienrol_data.csv"), lazy = FALSE) %>% 
  clean_names()

# df_hdr <- read_csv(here::here("data", "HDR", "hdr_complete.csv"), lazy = FALSE) 

```

```{r RDS delete sessions that did not run, eval = FALSE}

# delete the sessions that were scheduled but not run [will need to compare to our training spreadsheet]
  # use the n_courses code in the next chunk to make it easy to figure out which sessions didn't run

df_remove1 <- df_ienrol %>% 
  filter(course_name == "ARC Discovery Projects EOI PItching Session for CHASS/CEPSW/CBGL" & event_num == "3")

list_df <- list(df_ienrol, df_remove1)

df_ienrol <- list_df %>%reduce(anti_join)

rm(df_remove1, list_df)

```

```{r clean hdr data, eval = FALSE}

df_hdr <- df_hdr %>% 
  mutate (theme = case_when(role == "supervisor" ~ "HDR supervisors", 
                            role == "student" ~ "HDR students")) %>% 
  mutate (team = "OGR") %>% 
  rename(first_name = forename,
         last_name = surname) %>% 
  mutate (role = case_when (role == "supervisor" ~ "Academic", 
                                  role == "student" ~ "Student"))

# clean up some of the messy course names & categorisation
  # note: the counts of all vs sync vs async won't match if there are sync & a sync courses with the same name! 
  # add a different event num so it's counted twice in the 'all' courses

df_hdr <- df_hdr %>% 
    mutate (training_category = case_when(course_name == "HDR Supervisor Core Training Part 2" ~ " seminar", 
                                          course_name == "Delivery of Session: Dear New Postgrad" ~ "other",
                                          course_name == "Delivery of Session - HDR Industry Engagement and Internships" ~ "other",
                                          course_name == "Delivery of a Workshop" ~ "other",
                                          TRUE ~ as.character(training_category))) %>% 
   mutate (modality = case_when(course_name == "HDR Supervisor Core Training Part 2" ~ " synchronous",
                                course_name == "Delivery of Session: Dear New Postgrad" ~ "other",
                                 course_name == "Delivery of Session - HDR Industry Engagement and Internships" ~ "other",
                                  course_name == "Delivery of Workshop" ~ "other",
                                  TRUE ~ as.character(modality))) %>% 
  mutate (course_name = case_when(course_name == "Extra Core Attendance" ~ "HDR Supervisor Core Training Part 2 - Core Workshop", 
                                  course_name == "Extra Core attendance" ~ "HDR Supervisor Core Training Part 2 - Core Workshop",
                                  course_name == "Extra Core completion" ~ "HDR Supervisor Core Training Part 2 - Core Workshop", 
                                  course_name == "HDR Supervisor Core Training Part 2" ~ "HDR Supervisor Core Training Part 2 - Core Workshop", 
                                  course_name == "Module 11: HDR Intellectual Property" ~ "Module 11: HDR Student Intellectual Property",
                                  TRUE ~ as.character(course_name))) %>% 
  mutate (event_num = case_when(course_name == "Seminar: Inclusive approaches to designing, conducting and supervising HDR research" 
                                & modality == "asynchronous" ~ 2, 
                                TRUE ~ event_num)) %>% 
  mutate(course_name = str_remove(course_name, "^Seminar:\\s+")) %>% 
  mutate(course_name = str_remove(course_name, "^Workshop:\\s+")) %>% 
  mutate(course_name = str_remove(course_name, "^Epigeum\\s+"))


# don't remove HDR supervision here because it messes with our removal of overlapping sessions! 

  # df_async_hdr_category_1 <- df_async_sp_hdr %>%
#   dplyr::mutate(training_category = str_remove(training_category, "^online\\s+")) %>% # remove online from name 


# turn them into factors

cols <- c("event_num",
          "course_name",
             "college",
             "attendance_status",
          "role", 
          "modality",
          "training_category", 
          "theme")


df_hdr <- df_hdr %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(across(all_of(cols), ~factor(.))) 

# recode status and department so it matches the RTDC data

df_hdr <- df_hdr %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(portfolio = case_when (is.na(college) ~ "Other portfolios",
                                    TRUE ~ as.factor(as.character(college)))) %>% 
  relocate(portfolio, .after = college) %>% 
#  mutate(department = college) %>% # add this so we can run the same code in the report as we do with ienrol [or maybe not]
  select(-college) %>% 
  filter (course_name != "Research Town Hall with the Chief Scientist", # remove course from 2024
          course_name != "HDR Supervision: Industry Engagement for Researchers - panel discussion", # remove duplicate w/ our data
          course_name != "Industry Engagement for Researchers - panel discussion", # remove duplicate w/ our data
          course_name != "HDR Supervision: Mentee Roundtable", # remove duplicate w/ our data
          course_name != "University-Industry Partnerships: Panel Discussion") # remove duplicate w/ our data

# now remove HDR supervision! 

df_hdr <- df_hdr %>% 
  mutate(course_name = (str_remove(course_name, "^HDR Supervision:\\s*"))) %>% 
  mutate(course_name = case_when(course_name == "Dear New Postgrad: The hidden curriculum in postgraduate research" ~  
                                   "The Hidden Curriculum in Postgraduate Research",
                        course_name == "Dear New Postgrad: The Hidden Curriculum in Postgraduate Research" ~ 
                          "The Hidden Curriculum in Postgraduate Research",
                          course_name == "HDR Industry Engagement & Internships" ~ "HDR Industry Engagement and Internships",
                         course_name == "HDR Industry Engagement" ~ "HDR Industry Engagement and Internships",
                          course_name == "Supervising Research Students Flexibly" ~ "Supervising Students Flexibly",
                           course_name == "Delivery of Session: How to Supervise a PPPW" ~ "Delivery of session", 
                           course_name == "Other: 3MT Judging" ~ "3MT Judging",
                        TRUE ~ as.character(course_name)) %>%
  as.factor())
  

# check that we have all the data we need
  # summarise the data based on how many courses were held and how many folks attended each of the sessions
  # we are going to keep more variables than I normally would because we are going to use this df to join
  # this hdr data to our spreadsheet. I don't want to have to do this again later.

n_courses_hdr <- df_hdr %>% 
  select(c(theme, team, course_name, event_num, modality, data_source, attendance_status, fan, training_category)) %>% 
  filter(attendance_status == "Attended") %>%

  rename(attended = n)


# any course with zero attendees will not show up in n_courses. We need to manually add them back in.
```

```{r clean ienrol data}

df_ienrol <- df_ienrol %>%
  select (c(course_name, event_num, first_name, last_name, fan, department, job_status, status)) %>% 
  mutate (team = "RDS", 
          modality = "synchronous", 
          data_source = "ienrol", 
          training_category = "seminar") %>% # just naming all of our sessions this to differentiate from OGR other sessions
  rename (role = job_status)


# turn them into factors

cols <- c("course_name",
          "event_num",
             "department",
             "role",
             "status", 
            "team")

# recode status and department

df_ienrol <- df_ienrol %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(across(all_of(cols), ~factor(.))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(attendance_status = case_when (status == "attended" ~ "Attended", 
                                        status == "didnotattend" ~ "Did not attend")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(portfolio = case_when (grepl("Research", department) ~ "Portfolio of the Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Research)", #recode RDS as DVC(R)
                                    !grepl("College of", department) ~ "Other portfolios",
                                    department == "Other" ~ "Other",
                                    department == "Unknown" ~ "Other", 
                                    TRUE ~ as.factor(as.character(department)))) %>% 
  select(-status)

## clean up some of the course names

df_ienrol <- df_ienrol %>% 
  mutate (course_name = case_when(
    course_name == "Industry Engagement for Researchers -  Panel Discussion" ~ "Industry Engagement for Researchers: Panel Discussion", 
    course_name == "University-Industry Partnerships: panel discussion" ~ "University-Industry Partnerships: Panel Discussion",
                                  TRUE ~ as.character(course_name)))

# summarise the data based on how many courses were held and how many folks attended each of the sessions

n_courses_all_rds <- df_ienrol %>% 
#  filter(attendance_status == "Attended") %>% 
  count(course_name, event_num, data_source)

n_courses_rds <- df_ienrol %>% 
  filter(attendance_status == "Attended") %>% 
  count(course_name, event_num, data_source)

# the number of courses in ienrol don't match because some were cancelled, but they were not included
  # in the ienrol attendance data because there were zero attendees. Nothing to do at this point. 

# In 2025, we started including Mary's visits to the Colleges (this is the first year she did that) 
  # because we are going to support this more in the future. She doesn't have attendance data 
  # for those visits, so we have not included them in iEnrol. As such, there is a disconnect between
  # the number of sessions captured in the spreadsheet vs. ienrol. We will report this in the report. 

missing_ienrol <- 2

# any course with zero attendees will not show up in n_courses. We need to manually add them back in. 
  # 2025: we don't seem to have any courses that were not included, so skip this for now. 

# add_df <- list(course_name = "Research Ethics & Biosafety Applications Hands-on Workshop", 
#           event_num = "3", 
#           n = "0") %>% as_tibble %>% 
#   mutate(
#     course_name = as.factor(course_name), 
#     event_num = as.factor(event_num), 
#     n = as.integer(n))

# n_courses <- full_join(n_courses,add_df) 

# rm(add_df)

# write the clean ienrol data so I can use this later to match with workday
write_csv(df_ienrol,
           here::here("data", "cleaned", "cleaned_ienrol.csv"))

```

```{r clean spreadsheet data}

df_sp <- df_sp %>% 
   dplyr::rename(attended = no_attended, 
                 attended_in_person = no_in_person_attendees, 
                 attended_online = no_online_attendees, 
                 course_name = session) %>%
  select(c(theme, event, attended, course_name, attended_in_person, attended_online)) %>% 
  mutate(team = "RDS", 
         modality = "synchronous",
         data_source = "training spreadsheet", 
        training_category = "seminar") # just naming all of our sessions this to differentiate from OGR other sessions)


# rename these themes in the spreadsheet (before we turn theme into a factor)
  
df_sp [df_sp == "FNRC"] <- "First Nations Researchers Collective"
df_sp [df_sp == "Commerce"] <- "Post-award, Intellectual Property, and Commercialisation"



## clean up some of the course names

df_sp <- df_sp %>% 
  mutate (course_name = case_when(
    course_name == "Industry Engagement for Researchers Panel Discussion" ~ "Industry Engagement for Researchers: Panel Discussion", 
    course_name == "University-Industry Partnerships Panel Discussion" ~ "University-Industry Partnerships: Panel Discussion",
                                  TRUE ~ as.character(course_name)))
# turn them into factors

cols <- c("course_name",
          "event",
          "theme",
          "modality",
          "data_source",
            "team")

df_sp <- df_sp %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(across(all_of(cols), ~factor(.)))

# this number will differ from the T&D spreadsheet because we have had attendees that are not in iEnrol

n_attended_sp <- sum(df_sp$attended)

```
